doc.title: Frank Strazzeri interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999

title: Joining Elvis Presley's band
summary: He did tours with Elvis, including the Hawaii satellite show.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: I didn’t understand them, and neither I think did he understand me. Although I ended up working with Elvis Presley. I worked with Elvis, I did a couple of tours with him, and it’s on that paper.
I did a couple of tours with him.
You were on the Hawaii special? And the first live world satellite broadcast.

Yeah, he was a groovy guy. He was a nice guy. Every time — he and I sort of hit it off. I mean he was such a big star, that just being a musician playing with him, like myself coming in from the outside, you have to know the situation other than his immediate guys that had worked with him for years and knew him good. But a guy like me coming in adding on, didn’t know him at all and I’d just make the rehearsals without him. You play the music and the conductor and so forth, and you play the music so you don’t really get to know the guy until he goes on stage and he sings and you just play the music that you rehearsed, right? So I still didn’t know him. So one night he had a party at the hotel and so I go to the party, I go with all the musicians and their friends or wives that were invited to go. So we all go to this huge suite up atop, we were in Oklahoma somewhere. And so all these people, of course it’s a huge star, they’re all gravitating towards him, everybody wants to meet him and what have you. So he’s way on the far end of the room, and I can always remember this — I don’t know if this makes for interesting conversation—
